徒手攻击时命中率提高
Cause single target spells do splash damage
让单体法术产生溅射伤害

When you cast a spell that targets a single entity with an effect that changes their HitPoints, it splashes 1 health change to all nearby entities that are not blocked by obstructions.

Each level beyond the first adds 1 addition health change.

Spirit does not enhance the splash effect.
